items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt or used unit
items.note: Owners on CarComplaints report around $5,000 for transmission work on early cars.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner failure
items.job: Replace secondary and primary timing chain tensioners and guides
items.note: If the chain has already jumped, the engine may need major repair; JCNA cites around $10,000.

items.t: Erratic or harsh shifts from valve body or solenoid
items.job: Replace transmission valve body or shift solenoid

items.t: Torque converter lock-up fault
items.job: Replace torque converter (transmission removed)

items.t: Shift lever stuck in Park
items.job: Replace transmission manual control lever or shift cable
items.note: RepairPal lists about $320-$370 for shift cable replacement.

items.t: Low compression from worn Nikasil cylinder lining
items.job: Replace engine with steel-lined short block

items.t: Misfire or no-start from water in spark plug wells
items.job: Dry plug wells, replace damaged coil and fit updated covers

items.t: Misfire from failed ignition coil
items.job: Replace one ignition coil
items.note: RepairPal puts coil replacement at about $220-$490.

items.t: Thermostat failure and false low-coolant warnings
items.job: Replace thermostat and refill coolant

items.t: Coolant pump outlet hose bursting
items.job: Replace coolant hose and refill coolant

items.t: Check engine light from wet knock sensor
items.job: Replace knock sensor and seal cowl hole

items.t: Loss of power from failed fuel delivery hose
items.job: Replace fuel delivery hose

items.t: Fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump

items.t: Transmission may select reverse while moving forward (recall)
items.job: Reprogram transmission control module under recall

items.t: Electronic parking brake applying on its own (recall)
items.job: Replace electronic parking brake module under recall

items.t: Electronic parking brake won't release
items.job: Test and charge battery, service battery cable terminals
items.note: RepairPal lists about $50-$75 for battery terminal service. A new battery or brake module costs more.

items.t: Transmission may not fully engage Park (recall)
items.job: Replace parking pawl guide plate under recall

items.t: Front lower ball joint nuts loosening (recall)
items.job: Check ball joint torque or replace ball joints under recall

items.t: Seat belt buckle may not hold (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace seat belt buckles under recall

items.t: Weak air conditioning
items.job: A/C diagnosis and compressor control valve replacement

items.t: Ticking behind dashboard from blend door actuators
items.job: Replace climate blend door actuators

items.t: False warning lights and gauges dropping to zero
items.job: Update instrument cluster software

items.t: Key fob stops working
items.job: Replace and program key fob

items.t: Front clunk from sway bar bushings or control arms
items.job: Replace front stabilizer links or bushings
items.note: RepairPal lists about $150-$215 for a stabilizer link kit. Control arms cost more.

items.t: Power steering squeal
items.job: Power steering fluid additive service

items.t: Thump from rear differential
items.job: Fit rear subframe bushing restrictors or replace bushings

items.t: Water in rear footwells
items.job: Add door drain, reseal and dry carpets

items.t: Limp mode or supercharger belt noise on S-Type R
items.job: Replace supercharger belt or seal throttle position sensor

items.t: Harsh shifts or chirping from six-speed automatic
items.job: Reset adaptations and update transmission software

items.t: Can't shift out of gear from loose selector cable bracket
items.job: Secure or replace gear selector cable and bracket
items.note: RepairPal lists about $320-$370 to replace the shift cable.

items.t: Transmission fluid leak at wiring connector sleeve
items.job: Replace transmission connector sleeve and top up fluid

items.t: Brakes and rotors wearing out early
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
